Rust passes 50 unit tests, the portable consumer, doctest, rustfmt, Clippy with warnings denied, and direct LLVM coverage at 95.99% production-line coverage; vault-records, vault-pm-format, and vault-pm-application pass 151 downstream tests. C and C++ pass 597 existing-plus-portable checks under strict GCC, Clang, G++, Clang++, and MSVC builds. The C portable consumer also passes Clang AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Windows Clang's sanitizer runtime cannot safely unwind the repository's pre-existing C++ exception suite; the unchanged original C++ suite reproduces the same runtime failure, while ordinary strict builds pass on all five compilers. Ruff, MyPy, Bandit, RustSec, capability taxonomy, cross-language fixture, diff, state-graph, and collision gates pass. RustSec reports only the repository's two allowed unmaintained warnings. The late refresh reports 1,299 established identities and 4,455 slots with 849 singletons, 11,886 singleton gaps, 653 Rust singletons, zero collisions, and zero unknown buckets.

The suite covers stored, fixed, dynamic, multi-block, symbol 285, exact counted consumption, HDIST=32 with unused reserved slots, decoded dynamic distance symbols 30 and 31, stable payload-blind failures, hard and caller output caps, foreign decoding, incremental CRC-32, and ZIP compressed-payload cavity rejection. Ruff, Ruff format, MyPy, Bandit, TypeScript builds, Go build-tool tests, vet, module verification, trimpath build, strict JSON, dependency-graph, credential-pattern, diff, and runtime dependency audit gates pass. Both ZIP and PNG runtime audits report zero vulnerabilities.
